This Diwali, bringing our signature Mehfil to New York on Nov 6th- a magical evening of Bollywood and Sufi music!

About this Event

🪔 DIWALI WALI QAWALI🪔

A Bollywood Sufi Night✨ Hosted by 
🎶 MAJID ALI KHAN LIVE WITH HIS BAND | SUFI-BOLLYWOOD FUSION
Get ready for an unforgettable night of soulful melodies and Bollywood magic as Majid Ali Khan and his live band take over the iconic Darna Lounge in Arlington, Virginia!
Experience the mesmerizing fusion of traditional Sufi music and Bollywood’s most beloved melodies, brought to life through powerful vocals, captivating rhythms, and an atmosphere that will touch your soul.
From heart-wrenching Sufi classics to the songs that make you sing along with every word, this is more than a concert, it’s a celebration of music, culture, and connection, in the heart of Virginia.

🌟 THE NIGHT UNFOLDS🎤 7:00 PM – 10:00 PM | Majid Ali LIVE Immerse yourself in a soul-stirring live performance featuring the magic of Sufi and Bollywood fusion.
🎶 Sing along to timeless favorites like Teri Deewani and Rashq-e-Qamar.
🕯️ An Enchanting Experience Candlelit ambiance, breathtaking city views, and an unforgettable setting at Darna.
🔥 10:00 PM – 2:00 AM | Bollywood Afterparty When the live music ends, the party begins! Dance the night away to your favorite Bollywood hits, desi beats, and party anthems.
Your Qawali ticket includes FREE ACCESS to the Bollywood afterparty!
🍸 Top-shelf bar and food available for purchase.

🎟️ TICKETS & VIP EXPERIENCE🎫 General Admission starting at $34.99
